title: La vuelta al mundo de un novelista; vol. 1/3
summary: "La vuelta al mundo de un novelista; vol. 1/3" by Vicente Blasco Ibáñez is a travel narrative published between 1924 and 1925. The Spanish writer chronicles his journey around the world aboard the Cunard cruise ship Franconia from November 1923 to March 1924. Departing from New York, the voyage traverses territories across America, Asia, Africa, and Europe.
